off_overrides: Instance-only private copies of SwapPolicy, ModelPolicy, CandidatePolicy stiffness methods; no class/global mutation.
Finite estimate and fit.info>0 required; clipping 200..300000 retained.
Every valid estimate sets k_good=k_hat, f_set=max(F_measured,.3), kg_rel=sigma/k_hat; existing CENTRE wrapper retained.
Precision, chi and measurement-bound tests do not block k_good or post-acquisition k_bar.
Original conservative first-acquisition branch and ModelPolicy acquisition wrapper retained.
ff_jump=None; ff_band already None. Contact supervisor and servo identification unchanged.
Off-memory: every filter update has usable=True; finite/positive input guard retained; filter sigma used.

scoring.eligible: t>=1, true normal force>0 and k>0
scoring.smoothing: 0.2 s centered arithmetic boxcar of k; nearest ends within each continuous contact run
scoring.transition: abs(gradient(log(smoothed k)))>.2/s, expanded by .1 s each side
scoring.plateau: r<.05/s, farther than .3 s from expanded transition
scoring.event: scene B sc.events through end+.3 s; priority over both other segments
scoring.share: mean of episode segment ticks / episode eligible contact ticks
scoring.distributions: mean of per-episode median, IQR/1.349 and fractions; empty episodes omitted per channel
scoring.raw: current window output before memory, before CENTRE, only ticks actually estimated; missing raw never forward-filled
scoring.force: RMSE and P99 pooled segment ticks across episodes, true axial force log[:,18]-8
scoring.peak: whole-episode peak from t>=1; segment at peak tick; unscored peaks retained separately
